subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool half shipped in #93424?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-reproducible, but the open and closed candidate PRs overlap different session-routing scopes and choosing between a focused Mattermost fix, a shared-session fix, or duplicate tracking is a maintainer ownership call.

options.title: Replace With Focused Fix
options.body: Keep this issue canonical and sponsor a narrow Mattermost/session-route fix with live cron or heartbeat proof for thread-scoped wake delivery.

options.title: Adopt Shared Session Work
options.body: Promote #77442 or a successor as the canonical route-context fix only after it proves Mattermost cron/heartbeat delivery and avoids stale-route misassociation.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Tracker
options.body: Close this issue as a duplicate only if maintainers want #77378 to own all remaining Mattermost broken-delivery-context work.

recommendation.title: Replace With Focused Fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue canonical and sponsor a narrow Mattermost/session-route fix with live cron or heartbeat proof for thread-scoped wake delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent adjacent shared outbound-threading history and can judge whether the remaining fix belongs in Mattermost route persistence or shared session delivery recovery.
